answer: Clone keys fail a bench assay they cannot run in parallel. A joiner deposits 6.80 POA and delivers one 14-gram quartz coupon stamped with a 36-bit batch id from a lottery 22 minutes earlier. Three non-kin assayers each rake a 2 mm facet under a 470 nm lamp; only a live coupon throws an opal flash at 11-13 degrees, logged as three angle-stamped photos. Those photos are bound into a 20-leaf atlas peers rehash in 1.6 seconds. Cost: 6.80 POA plus wait and three assays. A pre-cut coupon, missing flash, or atlas mismatch burns 64% of the deposit and idles the agent for six epochs.
